note: New route (NEWSROOM_NEXT=1): how a World Bank table with every country open is narrowed to a few economies. One file, read by next_params.rs and next_run.rs (include_str!) and by newsroom.ts (prepareWorldBank), so the offered options, the allowed narrow values and the page wording cannot drift apart. The model only picks an option number; n and the rank year come from the program and the data.
n_source: 8 economies x 10 years = 80 rows, the chart row limit (MAX_CHART_ROWS); the cap only, the page shows the true count
year_share_source: the rank year is the latest year where at least this share of the economies with any value have one (both tables counted when ranked by another indicator), so a year few economies have reported yet is not used
zh_source: zh_scope is a program field of the page: its kicker (above the title and dek) and the eyebrow of the narrowed chart's scene (above the chart and its heroes), never model text; {n} is the count of economies the narrow record keeps. zh_line follows the chart's source line, {at} the record's rank year

options.label: the {n} economies with the highest value of this indicator in the latest year most economies have
options.prefix: Among the economies with the highest values of this indicator,
options.zh_scope: 在本指标最高的{n}个经济体中
options.zh_line: 按 {at} 年本指标取最高的 {n} 个经济体
